senses.gloss: to touch; to strike; to injure (with ב of object).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 13b:1">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:7">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>אילו נ׳ באשת וכ׳</he> if he touched Potifar’s wife.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:7">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:5">Koh. VIII, 5</cite>) <he>שלא נ׳ בו הדבר</he> the thing (the speech of the chief butler) did not harm him, v. <cite ref="N00179"><he>נִגְעָה</he></cite>.
Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ bot., a. e. נָגְעוּ בה, v. מַכָּה. Y. Yeb. I, end, 13ᵇ לא היו ב״ש נוֹגְעִין בו the Shammaites would not take up the case; a. v. fr.—נוֹגֵעַ בעדות an interested witness.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 34a:1">Snh. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיחזי כנ׳ בעדותו</he> he has the appearance of an interested witness.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 43a:1">B. Bath. 43ᵃ</cite> top <he>אמאי נוֹגְעִין בעדותן הן</he> why are they admitted to testify? Are they not interested witnesses? <cite ref="Kiddushin 43b">Kidd. 43ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>שעתידין הדברים לִיגַּע</he> for these things (which Joseph dreamt) shall come to pass; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 141">Yalk. ib. 141</cite>.

senses.gloss: to reach; to become the property of; to obtain; to cause to reach.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:5">B. Mets. X, 5</cite> <he>הִגִּיעוּךָ</he> they shall be thine.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:1">Arakh. VIII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:3">3</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 27a">27ᵃ</cite>, sq.) <he>הִגִּיעָתְךָ</he> it is thine (Bab. ed. <he>הִגַּעְתִּיךָ</he> I let thee have it), i.e. thy offer is accepted; Tosef. ib. IV, 20 <he>הִגַּעְתָּהוּ</he> thou hast acquired it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 6:7">Tosef. B. Bath. VI, 7</cite>, a. e. <he>הִגִּיעוֹ</he> it is his, i.e. he must pay for it. Y. Erub. III, 21ᵃ bot., a. e. <he>הִגִּיעוּךָ סוף</he> thou hast been made to reach the final conclusion, i.e. thou must admit, v. <cite ref="H00443"><he>חָוַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:3">Ber. IX, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 54a:3">54ᵃ</cite>) <he>שהחינו וקיימנו והִגִּיעָנוּ לזמן הזה</he> (Mish. ed. only <he>שהחינו</he>) who hast granted us life and sustenance and suffered us to reach this period.
Pes. X, 6 כן … יַגִּיעֵנוּ וכ׳ so may He allow us to reach &c.; a. v. fr.—הַגַּע עצמך put thyself in the position, i.e. suppose. Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ, v. זָוַג; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to arrive, to come to pass; to concern. Gen. R. l. c. שתחיית המתים מַגַּעַת בימיו that the resurrection of the dead will come to pass in his days. Ib. שהדברים מַגִּיעִים לבלהה וכ׳ that these things concern Bilhah. &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:3">Gitt. VIII, 3</cite> <he>כיון שה׳ לאויר וכ׳</he> as soon as the letter of divorce reaches the space over the roof.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:7">Ib. VII, 7</cite> <he>ה׳ לאנטיפטריס</he> if he came as far as Antipatris.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:4">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>שלא יַגִּיעַ לכם כשם שה׳ וכ׳</he> that the same may not happen to you as happened to the sons of Aaron.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 8:2">Ned. VIII, 2</cite> <he>עד שיגיע</he> until the time (Passover) comes, opp. <he>עד שיצא</he> until it is passed; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 6:14">Tosef. Toh. VI, 14</cite> <he>ומשהגיע</he>, v. <cite ref="J00088"><he>יָגַע</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Zevachim 88a">Zeb. 88ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>הוּגְּעוּ למים</he> Rashi (ed. <he>במים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) if they have come to such a condition as to need washing in water; <he>הוגעו לנתר ואהל</he> if they need cleansing with natron and aloes; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 381:3">Yalk. Ex. 381</cite> <he>הוּגְעֲלוּ במים</he> if they can be cleansed with &c., v. <cite ref="C01190"><he>גָּעַל</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: (denom. of נֶגַע) to afflict with leprosy.—Part. pass. מְנוּגָּע; f. מְנוּגַּעַת; pl. מְנוּגָּעִים; מְנוּגָּעוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 13:9">Neg. XIII, 9</cite> <he>מי שנכנס לבית המ׳</he> he who enters a house which is unclean on account of leprosy in the walls.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:2">Erub. VIII, 2</cite> <he>חצייה לבית המנ׳</he> half the time (required for consuming it) is the measure for the stay in a leprous house.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:1">Tosef. Neg. VI, 1</cite> <he>בית המנ׳ לא היה וכ׳</he> a case of a leprous house has never occurred &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אבנים מנ׳</he> stones from a leprous house; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 71a">Snh. 71ᵃ</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 2:3">Ker. II, 3</cite> <he>מצורע שנ׳ נגעים הרבה</he> a leper that had several attacks in succession (before being purified from the first); <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 9:7">Tosef. Neg. IX, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:30">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 30</cite> <he>המשכיר … וניתנ׳</he> if one rented a house to his neighbor, and it became leprous; <cite ref="Arakhin 20b">Arakh. 20ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
